duration_note: One competition season = one year, per the project brief. A new season can be opened by editing this file; all previous seasons remain in data/ledger and data/history as memory for later testing.
max_candle_series_note: Raised from 30 to 100 on 2026-09-22: the official batch candlestick endpoint (GET /markets/candlesticks, up to 100 tickers per request) makes covering the whole matched commodity universe cheap - one or two calls instead of thirty.
notes: Strategies are deliberately return-seeking, not risk-managed, per the brief: position sizing is expressed as target notional and the only hard constraints are real liquidity (order-book depth / exchange quote) and the one-position-per-instrument rule.
Fees are applied with the official Kalshi formula. Slippage is measured against the same snapshot's mid and stored on every trade.
